from typing import Annotated
from cyclopts import App, Parameter

app = App()


@app.default
def deploy(
    target: str,
    token: Annotated[str, Parameter(env_var="DEPLOY_TOKEN", help="API token")],
) -> None:
    """Deploy to a target with authentication token."""
    print(f"Deploying to {target} with token {token}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
